gen-comfortaa-gf-kiwi-maru: A ring-shaped c gives Comfortaa a friendly, neon-tube look, with every stroke drawn the same way. Kiwi Maru follows with a text serif that has traditional, editorial manners and generous spacing.
gen-comfortaa-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Round and bubbly, Comfortaa draws every stroke like glowing tube and spreads its letters out wide above a literary text serif. Padyakke Expanded One holds the lower half.
gen-dafont-aaargh-fs-bespoke-serif: Blunt and commanding, Aaargh holds one constant pen width throughout its letters. Bespoke Serif sits between monoline and sharp contrast, so Aaargh makes the statement while Bespoke Serif carries the dignified detail.
gen-dafont-amadeus-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, with sturdy thin lines and curves that stay open at the mouth. Literata would carry a long passage smoothly, while Amadeus stretches its words wide and bold above it.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-literata: Capture It towers on an enormous x-height, its letters nearly sealed shut. Literata opens its curves wide and lets thin and thick strokes differ slightly, so the heading shouts while the serif body talks.
gen-dafont-franchise-fs-literata: Tall, tight, and strong, like a bent steel rod. Literata follows with bowls that thin gracefully, and a long read in this serif would feel bookish and unhurried, never cramped.
gen-eater-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads classic and dignified, its gaping c staying open at any size and its rounded lowercase standing tall. Eater is the dark, aggressive one, while Epunda Slab does the patient work.
gen-eater-gf-fauna-one: Eater brings a dark, aggressive edge, with wide gaps between letters and short ascenders. And Fauna One, a literary text serif with a tall middle band, would carry a longer passage in a dignified, easy way.
gen-eater-gf-glegoo: Eater is dark and aggressive, with rounded letters that thicken slightly at the sides and wide gaps between them. Glegoo, a refined classic serif, gives it big counters to push against.
gen-eater-gf-kadwa: Crossbars a little slimmer than the vertical stems give Eater its dark, aggressive character and its wide, loose spacing. Kadwa, a text serif, is for steady reading.
